mapper.select: SELECT id FROM instrument WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO financial_report(instrument_id, period_end, report_type, published_at, version, revenue, net_profit, operating_cashflow, gross_margin, revenue_yoy, profit_yoy, source) VALUES(#{instrumentId}, #{periodEnd}, #{reportType}, #{publishedAt}, #{version}, #{revenue}, #{netProfit}, #{operatingCashflow}, #{grossMargin}, #{revenueYoy}, #{profitYoy}, #{source})
